values.note: Back-in 30-amp $44, 50-amp $49; waterside and pull-through $50 (30-amp) / $55 (50-amp); weekly $200-275, monthly $530-660. Rates include electricity, water, sewer and Wi-Fi, for two adults, two kids, one RV and one car; extra visitor or car $4 a day.

fees.source: http://cove.campground.world/rates.htm ('Back-in 30 AMP 50 AMP Daily $ 44.- $ 49.-'; 'Waterside ... $ 50.- $ 55,-'; 'Pull-Thru ... $ 50.- $ 55,-'; 'Rates are based on two adults, two kids, one RV and one car'), page carries no year; server Last-Modified 2026-01-25, read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: http://cove.campground.world/rates.htm (30 AMP and 50 AMP site rates; 'Our rates include electricity, water, sewer, full-hook-up and free WiFi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Recreation building with six private bathrooms (tile shower, porcelain toilet); laundry with four washers and dryers; boat ramp to Orange Lake free for guests, kayak launch and rentals, covered and floating slips.

facilities.source: http://cove.campground.world/amenities.htm ('six individual Bathrooms with tile showers, porcelain toilet'; 'Our Laundry room has four modern washers and dryers'; boat ramp 'There's no charge if stay with us') + http://cove.campground.world/rates.htm ('free WiFi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book online through the park's Firefly Reservations page (linked from its site) or call 352-484-2114 / email cove@campground.world; same-day reservations by phone. Check-in 1 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: http://cove.campground.world/reserve.htm (Firefly 'Reserve' link; 'Please call us for same day reservations ... 352-484-2114') + http://cove.campground.world/rules.htm (check-in/out), read 2026-10-21

note: On the shore of Orange Lake midway between Ocala and Gainesville, with waterside sites; all dirt/grass (no concrete pads). Nightly, short-term, seasonal and annual sites. On-site boat ramp, rental slips, kayak rentals, fishing. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages confirm $44 (back-in 30-amp) to $55 (waterside / pull-through 50-amp) nightly with full hookups, showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, pull-throughs; added online booking via the park's Firefly page. Rates page is undated (server Last-Modified Jan 2026); the Firefly engine carries a reCAPTCHA so no dated quote was taken. Not stated: site count (49 kept from note), dump station (kept as derived), season. Note trimmed of field facts and ratings.
